title: Claude Code Can Now Design Your UI Before Coding
description:
Comment "CANVAS" and I'll DM you the command + the prompt.

Your vibe coded app looks generic because the AI starts coding before anyone designs anything. Claude Code just fixed that:

1. Anthropic shipped a /design skill into Claude Code last week (research preview)
2. Run /design with a brief and Claude publishes a canvas of editable UI artboards instead of code
3. Click any element and change the type, spacing and colors right on the canvas
4. Pick the artboard you want, then tell Claude to implement that one
5. It runs inside your project, so it already carries your brand, your CLAUDE .md and your own skills
6. Works from the Claude Code CLI and Desktop. Needs v2.1.233 or later
7. Included on Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans

Design first, then code. That's the whole unlock.

Comment "CANVAS" and I'll DM you the command + the prompt I'd start with.

(Footage credits: Jay E | RoboNuggets and Steve Schoger on YouTube)

#claudecode #vibecoding #aitools #uidesign #buildinpublic
